title: 3 YEAR RECOMP TRANSFORMATION (From Husky to Jacked) - 50K SPECIAL
summary: For the 50K-subscriber special, NH shows his three-year recomp at a constant 210 lb, losing fat (especially love handles) while building muscle. He takes tape measurements: arms 18 in, forearms about 15 in, neck 17 in, calves 17 in, thighs 27 in. He shares lessons on how slow recomps are and on training frequency for forearms and calves, then announces a slow multi-year lean bulk.
claims: The channel reached 50K subscribers in three years
He recomped for three years without losing a pound and looks bigger and leaner
A recomp works because lifting forces adaptation, and without surplus fuel the body draws on fat reserves; it is slow but real
His earlier bulk to 240 lb was a disaster, and a suicide cut afterwards cost muscle while his love handles stayed
Slowly forcing the body to consume its fat stores is the only real fix for love handles; shortcuts are scams
Recomp priorities were rear delts, lats, calves and hamstrings, then the triceps long head; he deliberately ignored the rest of the shoulders
Arms went from 17.5 in to 18 in cold at the same 210 lb in three years: an extremely slow rate typical of an advanced recomp
Recomping is extremely slow when advanced; it suits sculpting, not people chasing size
He believes a natural can reach 19 and eventually 20-inch cold arms with years of consistent work
He stopped measuring because slow recomp numbers demoralised him even while his physique improved
Forearms went from about 13.5 in to about 15 in, but his inconsistent frequency had made them yo-yo
Frequency matters more than anything for forearms: they recover fast but have low work capacity, so train them directly at least 2-3 times a week
Towels and fat grips on pulling work grew his forearms best; when he dropped them for six months the forearms shrank
Neck went from 16 to about 17 in from neck curls supersetted with the main lift every lower body day: 25-35 lb for 40-50 reps
His neck is genetically strong: it grew to 16 in with no direct work
On a recomp, long-neglected muscles grow even without a surplus
Calves went up an inch to 17 in cold on the recomp; calves can grow despite claims they cannot
He lost months of calf progress by not training them frequently enough
An inch of calf a year is possible, especially while bulking; anyone can add at least two inches
Thighs grew one inch to 27 in even though he deliberately stopped prioritising quads for hamstrings
On a recomp you must pick your battles: prioritised lifts (hip hinges, triceps extensions) rose while bench and curls stalled with only 5-10 lb gains
Measurements may drop in the first recomp year because fat loss outpaces muscle gain; judge by performance and the mirror
The biggest benefit of the recomp was better mental and physical health and no pain
He is done with recomps and cuts; he plans to stay between about 15% and 18% bodyfat because he prefers mass to being shredded
Next phase: a slow lean bulk lasting 2-3 years toward 215-220 lb while keeping vascularity and definition
A belt squat machine will let him train quads more without loading his lower back
He will bring back vertical presses, which he had stopped because they grew his shoulders too much, now that his arms outgrow them
exercises: 25-35 lb, 40-50 reps, superset with main lower-body lift
